fields.title: 📖 Whoever earns a sin earns it against himself
fields.body:
🖋️ **Allah ʿazza wa jalla:**

> ***“Whoever earns a sin earns it only against himself. Allah is All-Knowing and Wise.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Responsibility is personal. In Ḥukm and Takfīr, guilt is not transferred wholesale.

immutable.source: 📝 aṭ-Ṭabarī und Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr zu Sūrah an-Nisāʾ 4:111.
